attributes.additional_details:
This petition is for pet owners  to be prosecuted for neglect  if a pet is needing treatment for burns to their feet or heat stroke 

We need to protect the pets
attributes.background:
Pet owners should be prosecuted if their pets are needing vet treatment  for burns to their feet or heat stroke 
As pet owners it our place to protect our pets, People are still walking their dogs in extreme heat, they should be prosecuted for neglect

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Make it illegal to walk dogs during extreme heat to prevent suffering and death." https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/764706
